title: Comfort Club Accessory Member Discount Amount on Replacement System Installations
content:
# Amount of the accessory member discount

## Clause

The accessory member discount on a Replacement System Installations contract is the tier's accessory discount percentage of the accessory charges on the contract, rounded to the cent half up.

The tier's accessory discount percentage is the member discount on accessories set by the Comfort Club tier of the homeowner's agreement in the Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements terms. The accessory charges on the contract are every accessory charge entry on the project ledger, added together.

## Order of the computation

1. Every percentage point that joins the discount is added to the tier's accessory discount percentage, making one percentage.
2. That one percentage is applied once to the total of the accessory charges on the contract.
3. The amount is multiplied by its multiplier; a multiplier of 1 leaves it unchanged.
4. Only the final amount is rounded to the cent half up.

The percentage points are added together before the percentage is applied; the percentage never acts on an amount already discounted.

## Worked example (hypothetical contract)

A hypothetical member on a tier whose accessory discount percentage is 10 percent has a $849.00 UV germicidal light and a $295.00 whole-home surge protector charged on the contract.

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Total of accessory charges | $1144.00 |
| 10 percent of $1144.00 | $114.40 |
| Accessory member discount, rounded to the cent | $114.40 |

## Worked order (hypothetical stage values)

On the same $1144.00 total with a 10 percent tier percentage, 3 further percentage points and a multiplier of 1.1: one percentage of 13 percent; 13 percent of $1144.00 is $148.72; multiplied by 1.1 it is $163.592; rounded half up, $163.59.
